name: Sembawang
registryBasis: The Singapore Land Authority publishes a current nationwide cadastral land-parcel GeoJSON described as the entire cadastral map of Singapore. Its polygon at the Sembawang WUP point was verified by geometry-only point-in-polygon inspection. This establishes public geometry at the locator, not title or legal boundary status.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: One complete SLA polygon is verified at the Sembawang settlement locator, but a faithful executable contract for the 144,800,984-byte weekly national snapshot, its transient resource link and revision-scoped native object identity has not been qualified. Source notices are informational. No cropped geometry corpus or proxy ID is substituted for the full source.
scopeLimits: SLA dataset metadata identifies a weekly updated nationwide GeoJSON snapshot (data from Nov 2025; last updated 2026-10-05) with polygon geometries. A temporary full download was used only to test the exact WUP point; its 144,800,984-byte source was deleted after retaining one point-containing polygon. Only snapshot-local OBJECTID_1 and geometry are retained; LOT_KEY and all other properties were discarded.
remainingUncertainty: Citywide parcel coverage is not established. For the Florida row, retained geometry is from a countywide service and municipal-boundary coverage is unverified. For other rows, no broader completeness claim is made.

executedQueries.query: Sembawang Singapore official cadastral land parcel map SLA geojson
executedQueries.scope: Find city-specific primary registry evidence and safe anonymous geometry-only sources.
executedQueries.result: The Singapore Land Authority publishes a current nationwide cadastral land-parcel GeoJSON described as the entire cadastral map of Singapore. Its polygon at the Sembawang WUP point was verified by geometry-only point-in-polygon inspection. This establishes public geometry at the locator, not title or legal boundary status. Official data.gov.sg metadata was anonymously fetched (HTTP 200) and listed a 144,800,984-byte GEOJSON maintained by SLA. The public poll-download endpoint returned 201; the dataset was streamed temporarily, with only geometry tested against the WUP point. One containing Polygon (73 ring vertices) was retained with snapshot OBJECTID_1 80598974 only. Full source deleted. OneMap separately advertises a LandLot basemap and LandQuery; no ownership or lot-number lookup was used.
